page.layout: One page of text. Running title at top. Right margin holds notes (Rom. 8. 18.; a–e). Catchword "infert" and signature "Aa 3" at foot. Left-edge fragment is from the facing page and is omitted.

l.i: Patres antiquos non tribuisse Martyribus vir-

main_text.l: CAtholicæ veritatis θεοφόροι[?], antiqui Patres, in
stoli, ubi de passionibus Christianorum Apo-
stolus clarè docuit, Non esse Condignas afflic-
futuram, Catholica sua judicia & Orthodoxa largiter exhibuerunt: (suprà:) quibus
monstrum hoc, quod dicitur de Condigno ex justitia aqualitate
apud Deum mercedem exigere, planè profligârunt.
Ratio prima, ex testimoniis iis quibus Patres
potest quis pati dignum gloriâ. Tertiò, {c}Etsi millies

l.i: moriamur, nihil dignum gerimus pro bonis

main_text.l: dignum regnis cælestibus. Quintò, {e}Æterna requies æterno
bi objicere solent Pontificii) si vox Dignum

page.notes: Greek word at the start of Sect. II read as θεοφόροι[?]; uncertain. Marginal note "a" read as "Albanaf." on the scan; the likely reading is Athanas.[?] and should be checked. Right-margin marks "/" and faint show-through from the facing page were omitted. Spelling "aqualitate" and "Ratio" kept as printed.
